structured.answer: The ones worth looking into for me are an S&P 500 fund (maybe MSCI World), my קרן השתלמות, and maybe a קרן כספית for money I need handy. But the page never says what anything costs or what to do first, so I didn't do anything yet.

stuck.why: Didn't get the split between where the money is kept and what it's invested in. Is an S&P 500 fund its own product or does it go inside a קרן השתלמות?
Thought it was a pension thing for older people, but it says 'אפשר למשוך בכל עת'. Confused, so I moved on.
No next step, no recommendation, no numbers. Didn't know what to do first.
